title: 第13章 维斯洛特下第14章 霜狼小径
content_zh:
卡洛斯没有让他失望。
在接近末尾的部分，专门有一章名为《凡俗之外：行走于阴影与传说之间的职业者》。
开篇卡洛斯就明确指出，在维斯洛特大陆，真正的决定性的力量，依然牢牢掌握在四大帝国手中。
庞大的的军队，才是这片大陆的基石，即使是强如巨龙，也不敢正面冲击一支装备精良的骑士团。
尤其是配备专门对抗大型生物的“猎龙弩”
，个体的超凡力量，在钢铁洪流和严密的军阵面前，依旧还要靠边站。
书中详细介绍了两种在民间流传较广的职业。
第一种被称之为巫师的特殊群体。
卡洛斯描述的巫师，与凯撒前世幻想中挥手间山崩地裂的法师不同，他们的力量更偏向于研究，而非直接的破坏。
他们深入研究能量的流动、生命的奥秘，擅长制造各种诡异的巫术物品，甚至创造或改造生物。
就像灰烬帝国的开国主宰，就是因为在一次意外之中救了一位流浪的神秘巫师，这位神秘的流浪巫师为了报答救命之恩。
融合多种生物，创造出了名为“巨龙”
的强大存在，让这种生物历代受到灰烬帝国皇室的驱使。
他们的战斗方式通常是侧面作战，毕竟一个强大的诅咒或一场精心策划的瘟疫，可能比一个火球术造成的破坏更大。
卡洛斯特别强调，巫师的身体通常并不比普通人强壮多少，他们极度依赖知识、准备和环境。
卡洛斯对其的评价是:“巫师更像是学者和阴谋家的混合体，力量强大但脆弱，依赖智慧而非蛮力，他们创造价值，也带来灾祸，是帝国既拉拢又警惕的对象”
在民间第二个比较庞大的团体，是被称之为猎魔人的群体。
卡洛斯将其分为两大主流，但并非绝对互斥。
“血脉契约型“类似于北境主宰苏尔特·奥拉，或者灰烬帝国的龙骑士，卡洛斯认为龙骑士本质上也属于一种特殊的猎魔人契约。
他们通过某种古老神秘的仪式与强大的生物签订契约，直接获得该生物的部分力量。

这种力量通常表现为身体素质的全面提升，特殊感官、以及一些类法术能力。
这种契约往往伴随着巨大的代价和风险，且多为一脉单传，因为契约的仪式和沟通对象，或是血脉移植的手法是核心秘密。
其次便是有着完整传承的猎魔人家族，这才是民间最常见的猎魔人。
他们自身可能并不具备天生的魔力，但他们拥有代代相传的知识体系。
这包括对各种魔物的弱点，习性，出没地点的了解，不同流派的猎魔人都有着不同的应对方法。
一套经过无数代人用生命试错验证出来的“魔药”
配方体系，饮用后能在短时间内，能赋予猎魔人各种奇特的能力。
每一种魔药的配方和熬制方法都是家族的核心机密，绝不外传，猎魔人需要承受极大的痛苦和风险来使用魔药。
无论哪种类型，猎魔人都需要经受极其严苛的训练，他们接受委托清除威胁，换取报酬。
卡洛斯对这个群体的评价则为：“猎魔人的力量更直接，更专注于战斗，身体经过强化或改造，比巫师更能适应残酷的近身搏杀”
凯撒合上书，长长地吐出一口白气，不知不觉，他已经在冰冷的地面上坐了好几个小时。
信息量太大了！
凯撒花了相当长的时间，才将卡洛斯描述的庞杂世界体系初步梳理清晰。
四大帝国、混乱的西大陆、巫师、猎魔人……一个危机四伏的奇幻世界在他眼前徐徐展开。
“所以……”
凯撒低头看了看自己的双手，又摸了摸自己血肉中藏着的那本只有他自己能感知到的《血肉之书》。
“我现在的状态，应该算是……猎魔人？而且是第二种？”
这很符合卡洛斯描述的“知识魔药型”
猎魔人的特征，依靠特殊的知识配方来制造强化自身或对抗怪物的工具。
“但是……配方太少了”

凯撒的眉头又皱了起来，兴奋过后是更深的焦虑和紧迫感。
content_en:
Carlos did not disappoint.
Near the end, there is a dedicated chapter called "Beyond the Mortal: Professionals Walking Between Shadows and Legends".
Carlos clearly pointed out at the beginning that in the continent of Westeros, the real decisive power is still firmly in the hands of the four empires.
A huge army is the cornerstone of this continent. Even one as powerful as a dragon would not dare to attack a well-equipped knights head-on.
Especially equipped with a "Dragon Hunting Crossbow" designed to fight against large creatures.
, the extraordinary power of individuals still has to stand aside in the face of the torrent of steel and the tight military formation.
The book introduces in detail two professions that are widely spread among the people.
The first is a special group called wizards.
The wizards described by Carlos are different from the wizards in Caesar's previous life fantasy who waved their hands and the earth collapsed. Their power is more focused on research rather than direct destruction.
They study deeply the flow of energy and the mysteries of life, are good at making all kinds of weird witchcraft items, and even create or transform living things.
Just like the founder of the Ashes Empire, he saved a mysterious wandering wizard in an accident. This mysterious wandering wizard wanted to repay the favor of saving his life.
Fusion of various creatures creates a creature called "The Dragon"
The powerful existence has allowed this creature to be driven by the royal family of the Ash Empire for generations.
Their fighting style is usually from the side, after all, a powerful curse or a well-planned plague can cause more damage than a fireball.
Carlos particularly emphasized that wizards' bodies are usually not much stronger than ordinary people, and they rely heavily on knowledge, preparation, and environment.
Carlos's evaluation of him is: "Wizards are more like a mixture of scholars and conspirators. They are powerful but fragile, relying on wisdom rather than brute force. They create value and bring disasters. They are the objects of attraction and vigilance for the empire."
The second relatively large group among the people is the group called demon hunters.
Carlos divides them into two main streams, which are not necessarily mutually exclusive.
The "blood contract type" is similar to Surte Aura, the Lord of the North, or the dragon knights of the Ashes Empire. Carlos believes that the dragon knights are essentially a special kind of demon hunter contract.
They sign a contract with a powerful creature through some ancient mysterious ritual and directly obtain part of the creature's power.
This power usually manifests itself as an overall improvement in physical fitness, special senses, and some spell-like abilities.
This kind of contract is often accompanied by huge costs and risks, and is mostly passed down by a single line, because the rituals and communication objects of the contract, or the blood transplantation method are core secrets.
Next is the demon hunter family with a complete heritage. This is the most common demon hunter among the people.
They may not possess innate magic themselves, but they have a body of knowledge that has been passed down from generation to generation.
This includes understanding the weaknesses, habits, and haunting locations of various monsters. Demon hunters of different schools have different methods of dealing with them.
A set of "magic potions" that have been proven through countless generations of trial and error in life.
The formula system can give the demon hunter various strange abilities in a short period of time after drinking it.
The formula and brewing method of each potion are the core secrets of the family and will never be told outside. Demon hunters need to endure great pain and risks to use potions.
No matter what type, witchers need to undergo extremely rigorous training. They are entrusted to eliminate threats in exchange for rewards.
Carlos's evaluation of this group is: "The power of demon hunters is more direct and focused on combat. Their bodies have been strengthened or modified, and they are better able to adapt to brutal close combat than wizards."
Caesar closed the book and exhaled a long white breath. Unknowingly, he had been sitting on the cold ground for several hours.
There is so much information!
It took Caesar a long time to begin to understand the complex world system described by Carlos.Sort it out clearly.
The four great empires, the chaotic Western Continent, wizards, demon hunters... a fantasy world full of dangers slowly unfolded before his eyes.
"So..."
Caesar looked down at his hands, and then touched the "Book of Flesh" hidden in his flesh and blood that only he could perceive.
"In my current state, I should be considered...a demon hunter? And the second type?"
This fits well with what Carlos describes as the “knowledge potion type.”
The characteristic of a witcher is that he relies on special knowledge formulas to create tools to strengthen himself or fight against monsters.
"But...the formula is too little"
Caesar's brows furrowed again, the excitement followed by a deeper sense of anxiety and urgency.
